theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.assembled_prize_yields_counterexample
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} (G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryPayload D) (C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassPayload D G),   MCore.HodgePrizeSeparationPayload D G C → MCore.ClayHodgeCounterexample D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.both_true_impossible
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData}, MCore.HodgeProofLane D → MCore.HodgeRefutationLane D → False

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.claim_test_no_simultaneous_survivors
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData}, MCore.HodgeProofLane D → MCore.HodgeRefutationLane D → False

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.concreteFiniteSpan_implies_abstract
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G}   (O : MCore.HodgeRationalCohomologyOperations D G C) {α : D.Cohomology G.Xsurgery (2 * C.p)},   MCore.HodgeConcreteFiniteSpanAt O α → D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses α

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.concrete_span_model_proves_notAlgebraic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G},   MCore.HodgeConcreteSpanSeparationModel D G C → ¬D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses C.h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.finiteSpanEval_sound
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G}   (O : MCore.HodgeRationalCohomologyOperations D G C) (terms : List (MCore.HodgeCycleSpanTerm D G C)),   D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses (MCore.finiteSpanEval O terms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.finiteSpan_iff_abstract_given_complete
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G}   (O : MCore.HodgeRationalCohomologyOperations D G C),   MCore.HodgeFiniteSpanCompleteness O →     ∀ (α : D.Cohomology G.Xsurgery (2 * C.p)),       D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses α ↔ MCore.HodgeConcreteFiniteSpanAt O α

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.finiteWitnessSeparator_proves_notAlgebraic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G}   (O : MCore.HodgeRationalCohomologyOperations D G C),   MCore.HodgeFiniteSpanCompleteness O →     MCore.HodgeFiniteWitnessSeparator O → ¬D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses C.h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.negative_formulation_closes
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {A A' P : Prop}, MCore.NegativeFormulationPattern A A' P → A → ¬A' ∧ (A ∧ P → False)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.scientific_final_proof_reaches_root
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} (F : MCore.HodgeFinalFail D),   (MCore.scientific_final_proof F).root = MCore.scientific_final_root F

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.scientific_payload_final_fail_roundtrip

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.separator_iff_notAlgebraic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G},   Nonempty (MCore.HodgePrizeSeparatorCore D G C) ↔ ¬D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses C.h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.separator_proves_notAlgebraic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} {G : MCore.HodgePrizeGeometryCore D} {C : MCore.HodgePrizeClassCore D G},   MCore.HodgePrizeSeparatorCore D G C → ¬D.isRationalLinearCombinationOfCycleClasses C.h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.terminal_payload_excludes_opposite
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {D : MCore.ClayHodgeData} (P : MCore.HodgeTerminalScientificPayload D),   match P with   | MCore.HodgeTerminalScientificPayload.proved statement => ¬Nonempty (MCore.HodgeRefutationLane D)   | MCore.HodgeTerminalScientificPayload.refuted construction => ¬MCore.HodgeProofLane D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.truth_falsehood_repulsion
